The Petitioner has made the following prayer: _“(a) Allow the present petition;_ _(b) Take on record the change in name of the transmission licensee/Petitioner from “Maheshwaram Transmission Limited” to “Maheshwaram Transmission Private Limited”;_ _(c) Direct that necessary endorsement be made on the transmission licensee with regard to change of name of “Maheshwaram Transmission Limited” to “Maheshwaram Transmission Private Limited”;_ _(d) Pass necessary orders to ensure that no prejudice is caused to the Petitioner on account of the above name change; and_ _(e) Pass any such further/other orders that this Commission may deem fit in the interest of equity and justice.”_ 2. By order dated 23.11.2015 in Petition No. 218/TL/2015, Maheshwaram Transmission Limited (MTL) was granted an inter-State transmission license bearing License No. 36/Transmission/2015/CERC, to establish the Transmission System for “Connectivity Lines for Maheshwaram (Hyderabad) 765/400 kV Pooling sub-station”. 3. The Petitioner has submitted that an application under Section 14(1) of the Companies Act, 2013 read with rule 41 of the Companies (Incorporation) Rules, 2014 was filed before the Regional Director (WR), Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Mumbai, seeking approval for the conversion of the company into a Private Limited Company, which was duly approved _vide_ Order dated 4.6.2025 by the Regional Director. Thereafter, the Regional Director sanctioned the alteration of Clause I of the Memorandum of Association, wherein “Maheshwaram Transmission Limited” was substituted with “Maheshwaram Transmission Private Limited”. Order in Petition No. 81/RC/2026 Page 3 4. Subsequently, the Ministry of Corporate Affairs also issued a Certificate of Incorporation dated 2.7.2025 consequent upon conversion to a private company, duly recording the aforesaid conversion. 5. The Petitioner has submitted that, consequent to the change in name of the transmission licensee, i.e., the Petitioner, there has been no change in the composition or structure of the company. ## **Analysis and Decision** 6. This Petition is being decided by way of circulation. 7. We have considered the submission of the Petitioner and perused the documents available on record. The Petitioner was granted the transmission license _vide_ order dated 23.11.2015 in Petition No. 218/TL/2015. 8. Consequent to the issuance of the certificate dated 2.7.2025, by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, as noted above, we direct that the name of the Transmission Licensee be changed from “Maheshwaram Transmission Limited” to “Maheshwaram Transmission Private Limited” in the records of the Commission. It is further stipulated that Maheshwaram Transmission Private Limited shall remain unequivocally bound by the terms and conditions of the inter-State transmission licence originally granted to Maheshwaram Transmission Limited, provisions of the Transmission Service Agreement, Transmission Licence Regulations, and the Electricity Act. 9. We direct that the necessary endorsement be made on the transmission licence with regard to the change of name of “Maheshwaram Transmission Limited” to Order in Petition No. 81/RC/2026 Page 4 “Maheshwaram Transmission Private Limited”. Except for the name, there shall be no change in the terms and conditions of the licence. 10. Let an extract copy of this order be sent to the Central Government (the Ministry of Power), the Central Electricity Authority and the Central Transmission Utility of India Limited in terms of sub-section (7) of Section 15 of the Electricity Act, 2003, for their information and record. 11. Accordingly, the Petition No. 81/RC/2026 is allowed in terms of the above. **Sd/sd/sd/sd/(Ravinder Singh Dhillon) (Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.)
